s.how: Slice 300g aged cheddar and 3 crisp apples. Arrange with 200g crackers on a board. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Bake 1kg thick frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Toss with salt and serve with tomato sauce. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties and grill 4 minutes a side, adding cheddar at the end. Fry 4 rashers bacon. Build in 4 buns with lettuce, tomato, bacon and sauce.

w.how: Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs and 400ml milk into a batter. Cook ladles in a buttered pan for 2 minutes a side. Stack and pour over 250ml maple syrup.

d.how: Fill 4 large glasses with ice and pour 300ml cold cola into each. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
